object: a wind-up animal band: a drumming bear, a honking goose, and a tiny wind-up bunny
morph: the band stacks instruments into a wrong shape, then fixes it into 孫
creativeAngle: 發條樂團先排成歪的字形，發現後一撥修正；最後小發條兔對應「孫女」。
promptEn: An 8-second silly animated clip, bright pastel look, soft daylight, no dark grading. On a teal stage with orange spotlights, a wind-up animal band stands in a row: a bear with a drum, a goose with a honking horn, and a tiny wind-up bunny with a key on its back. 0–1.6s: The bear bangs the drum and the first 孫 is spoken; on each beat the instruments launch off the stage and stack in a proud but lopsided wrong shape, the horn upside down. 1.6–3.2s: The goose honks, the second 孫 is spoken, and everyone freezes, tilts heads, and notices the shape is wrong, shrugging in comic unison. 3.2–4.7s: One quick fix: the bear whacks the drum, the pieces flip like pancakes, and the correct 孫 clicks into place in violet with a cymbal-less shimmer. 4.7–5.7s: As 孫女 is spoken, the tiny wind-up bunny girl with a bow cranks forward from behind the drum, and the goose honks a soft toot. Final hold (about 5.0–8.0s): the band sways in time and the bunny spins on its key; the glyph does not move. Narration: one gentle off-screen voice, Taiwan standard Mandarin, speaks only this line and nothing else, each syllable clear with its tone: 孫、孫、孫女（ㄙㄨㄣ、ㄙㄨㄣ、ㄙㄨㄣ ㄋㄩˇ）. The first 孫 lands at about 0.9s, the second 孫 at about 2.5s, and the word 孫女 at about 4.8s, each timed to the picture described above. Keep 孫 as the one and only piece of writing on screen, a bold saturated color against a pale bright background, correctly formed with every stroke legible; nothing else is written anywhere. The glyph 孫 fills roughly 70% of frame height, centered and uncropped, and stays perfectly still for the final 3 seconds while the lead keeps playing away from the strokes. No real people, no flashing.

conceptZh: 兒子或女兒的小孩，就是爺爺奶奶的孫子、孫女。
object: a caped action-figure hero whose far-too-long cape flops over his head the moment he jumps, plus a tiny felt ninja standing in plain sight behind a potted plant
morph: the blind hero ricochets off floor, wall, ceiling and the ninja's head, and every bounce clacks one chunk of 孫 into place: the 子 on the left first, then the 系 on the right, with the last bounce dropping him on top of the finished glyph
creativeAngle: 全新的彈跳連鎖版：披風英雄一起跳披風就蓋住眼睛，閉著眼亂彈，每撞一下就把一塊筆畫敲進去，左邊的子、右邊的系分兩段清楚組好。布忍者躲在花盆後面當「牆壁」被撞，煙霧彈失誤引爆，煙散後露出他「躲」的其實是一個小辮子布娃娃，正好對上孫女這個詞。和上一版的樂隊疊字完全不同，動作大、節奏快、結構正確。
promptEn:
An 8-second slapstick animated clip, bright pastel look, soft even daylight, no dark grading, no flashing. A plain mint-green room with a cream floor, a pale wall on the right, and nothing busy behind. The lead is an original caped action-figure hero with a chunky plastic body, a star on his chest and a red cape three sizes too long. On the far right, a tiny felt ninja stands behind a small potted plant that hides only his knees, convinced he is invisible, holding a round smoke bomb.

0–1.2s: The hero stands on a little springboard at the far left, points hard at a glowing empty spot in the center of the room, flexes, crouches, and launches. The instant he leaves the board the long cape flops forward over his whole head like a bag. The first 孫 is spoken right as he leaps.

1.2–3.0s: Blind bounce chain. He rebounds off the floor with a BOING, off the ceiling with a BONK, off the left wall, each hit squashing and stretching him, and every impact clacks one bold violet piece of the glyph into the center: the three strokes of the left part 子 drop in one by one, ending with its long horizontal. Each piece lands with a satisfying wooden clack and a small puff of dust.

3.0–4.6s: The big one. The hero ricochets straight across the room and BONKS off the felt ninja's head as the second 孫 is spoken; the ninja wobbles, and his smoke bomb goes off at the wrong moment in a soft grey puff. The hero spins through the puff in a tight pinball rattle, floor, wall, floor, and in rapid fire the right part 系 clacks together stroke by stroke beside the 子, the short top stroke first, then the twisting middle, then the three bottom strokes. On the very last bounce he drops down and lands sitting proudly on top of the finished 孫, the cape finally sliding off his face to reveal a dizzy, delighted grin and spinning eyes.

4.6–5.6s: The smoke clears and the word 孫女 is spoken exactly as the felt ninja looks down and discovers the "rock" he has been hiding behind is a tiny felt doll with pigtails and a bow; he holds her up proudly as if he found her, the hero gives a happy thumbs-up from the top of the glyph.

Final hold (5.0–8.0s): the glyph 孫 stays perfectly still, bold solid violet against the pale mint background, every stroke legible, filling roughly 70% of frame height, centered and uncropped with clean margins. The cape flops over the hero's head one more time and he slides gently off the glyph to sit on the floor beside it, out of the way of the strokes, where he does a tiny seated victory flex while the ninja tiptoes off behind his plant.

Audio: one warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads only this line, slowly and distinctly, each syllable with its clear tone, and nothing else: 孫、孫、孫女（ㄙㄨㄣ、ㄙㄨㄣ、ㄙㄨㄣ ㄋㄩˇ）. The first 孫 lands at about 0.8s on the launch, the second at about 3.2s on the bonk off the ninja's head, and the word 孫女 at about 4.9s as the pigtailed doll is revealed. Stop after the word. Only soft cartoon boings and clacks underneath, quieter than the voice, no music louder than the voice.

The single glyph 孫 is the only piece of writing on screen; no vocabulary text, subtitles, watermark, logos or other characters anywhere. No real people, no realistic human figures, no live-action presenter; the hero and ninja read unmistakably as a plastic action figure and a felt toy.

conceptZh: 布忍者只想輕輕按爺爺家的小門鈴，卻蓄力過猛、煙霧彈提早爆開，整隻衝過頭撞翻一籃紫色毛氈條，布條啪啪貼上牆拼成「孫」，他冒煙滑回來輕輕一按，白鬍子爺爺開門抱住他這個孫子。
object: a tiny felt ninja, a small felt doorbell button beside a little round toy doorway, and a basket of violet felt strips and sticks
morph: the overshooting ninja smashes the basket and the flung violet felt strips slap flat onto the pale wall one by one, landing as the correct strokes of 孫 (子 on the left, 系 on the right)
creativeAngle: 之前兩版是樂隊排字和披風英雄彈跳，這版改成「力氣太大」的單一笑點：小小的任務（按門鈴）配上誇張的蓄力、提早爆開的煙霧彈和衝過頭的大撞擊，撞飛的布條直接成為筆畫。改用「孫子」並讓忍者本人就是那個孫子：唸到詞的時候，爺爺開門抱住他，聽到的和看到的是同一件事。這個笑點不需要玩具戰士，所以沒有讓他出場。
promptEn:
An 8-second slapstick animated clip, bright pastel look, soft even daylight, no dark grading, no flashing. Simple set: a pale cream felt wall with a sky-blue floor and nothing busy behind. At the lower right edge of the wall sits a small round toy doorway with a closed felt door and, beside it, a tiny round doorbell button on a short post. Near the right wall stands a wicker basket of violet felt strips. The lead is an original tiny felt ninja with stitched eyes and a floppy mask tail. He is terrible at hiding but sure nobody can see him.

0–1.5s: The ninja tiptoes in from the left and "hides" behind a single thin bamboo stick, which covers none of him. He spots the tiny doorbell and points at it with fierce focus. Then he winds up hugely for this tiny job: windmill arms, deep crouch, a quivering stomp.

1.5–3.0s: His smoke bomb goes off early at his own feet, POOF, and he rockets out of the soft grey puff like a cannonball. The first 孫 is spoken right as he launches. He zooms straight past the little button and BONKS into the basket by the right wall, squashing flat like a pancake.

3.0–4.6s: The basket flips, and violet felt strips fly up and slap flat onto the center of the wall, one by one with soft thwaps. First the left part 子 forms (its hook, its vertical hook and its rising tick), then the right part 系 (the short top slash, the twisting middle, the vertical hook and the two side dots). The result is a correctly formed 孫. The second 孫 is spoken as the last strip snaps into place. The ninja peels off the wall and skids back left on his heels with little smoke wisps rising from his feet, eyes spinning, grinning.

4.6–5.4s: He tiptoes up to the button, wiggles one finger and gives it the gentlest tap. Ding. The little door swings open and a felt grandpa with a huge fluffy white beard leans out and scoops the ninja into a big hug, patting his head. The word 孫子 is spoken at this exact moment.

Final hold 5.0–8.0s: the glyph 孫 stays perfectly still in bold solid violet on the pale cream wall, centered and uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with clean margins. Down at the lower right, clear of the strokes, the ninja tries to "hide" inside grandpa's beard, his feet sticking out and kicking happily, and a tiny wrong-time smoke puff pops harmlessly by the doorway.

Audio: one warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads only this line, slowly and distinctly, with clear tones on exactly these syllables: 孫、孫、孫子（ㄙㄨㄣ、ㄙㄨㄣ、ㄙㄨㄣ ㄗˇ）. The first 孫 comes at about 1.6s, the second at about 4.0s and 孫子 at about 5.2s. Stop after the word. Underneath, only soft cartoon poofs, thwaps and one gentle ding, all quieter than the voice.

The single glyph 孫 is the only writing on screen: no subtitles, vocabulary text, watermark or logos. All characters read unmistakably as stitched felt toys, never as real people.
